market_hypothesis: Over three completed five-minute bars, price and taker flow move in one direction while open interest builds, but the broad account long-short ratio moves materially in the opposite direction. The new opposing inventory is trapped rather than informed when the current bar still closes in the price direction. Its liquidation or covering demand supplies continuation toward the next liquidity area.

state_machine.prior_atr: median true range of the previous completed 48 five-minute bars, shifted one bar
state_machine.open_interest_change: log change over three completed bars
state_machine.crowd_change: log change in count_long_short_ratio over three completed bars
state_machine.taker_change: log change in sum_taker_long_short_vol_ratio over three completed bars
state_machine.confirmation: the current completed five-minute candle closes in the observed price direction
state_machine.entry: market at the next one-minute open
state_machine.stop: opposite extreme of the three completed five-minute observation bars plus 0.15 prior ATR
state_machine.stop_gap_policy: worse of stop or one-minute open

quantity_rule: current NAV times 0.03 divided by per-unit expected stop loss including price distance, entry and stop costs, market impact and funding allowance
